question: Q2
title: Property names U+FF61... and U+1F600... in either order
why: RFC 8785 sorts by UTF-16 code units, which puts the emoji (surrogate D83D) before U+FF61; code-point sorting puts it after. Both sides must give the same digest, and the known answers only match an implementation that sorts by UTF-16.
